name: vote
title: Vote
description: A score that a reader moves up or down by one.
use: The score of an answer, a post or a comment that each reader may raise or lower once. The arrows are two native radios of one group, so the vote works and is submitted with no script; a few lines of script let a second press take the vote back.

instead.when: The reader gives a score out of a few stars
The reader answers with an emoji, and several answers can stand side by side
The reader picks one answer to a question
The number is a quantity the reader types or steps to any value

keyboard.action: Move the vote to the other arrow, as a radio group does
Enters the group at the chosen arrow, or the first, and leaves it; the group is one tab stop
Votes with the arrow that has focus; with the script, takes back the vote it already holds

classes.name: vote
classes.description: The group, on a fieldset named by aria-label or a legend: an up arrow, the score and a down arrow, stacked. Set --votes to the score without the reader's vote

classes.name: vote-horizontal
classes.description: The arrows beside the score, for a row of actions under a comment; the score keeps the width of three figures

classes.name: vote-up
classes.description: The up arrow, a radio named "Upvote": a quiet 32px square whose arrow fills with ink while checked

classes.name: vote-score
classes.description: The score, written by the counter when the element is empty: --votes, one more or one less. On an output, it is announced when it changes. Text inside it, such as 1.2k, is shown instead

classes.name: vote-down
classes.description: The down arrow, a radio of the same name as the up arrow, named "Downvote"

states.name: checked
states.description: The arrow fills with ink and the score is one more

states.name: checked
states.description: The arrow fills with ink and the score is one less

states.name: disabled
states.description: On the radios or on the fieldset: the arrows take disabled ink and the score stays, for a post the reader cannot vote on

properties.name: --votes
properties.description: The score without the reader's vote; the checked arrow adds or takes one

properties.name: --vote-size
properties.description: The side of each arrow's square, 44px on a touch screen

example:
<fieldset class="vote" aria-label="Vote on this answer" style="--votes: 41">
  <input type="radio" class="vote-up" name="vote" value="up" aria-label="Upvote">
  <output class="vote-score"></output>
  <input type="radio" class="vote-down" name="vote" value="down" aria-label="Downvote">
</fieldset>
